headline: Exceptional noise cancelling and battery life
review_text: The active noise cancellation is unmatched and blocks out office chatter completely. Battery easily lasts 30 hours on a single charge. Super comfortable padding.

headline: Solid audio but slightly bulky case
review_text: Soundstage is very wide and clear. Microphones pick up voice nicely during Zoom calls. Only drawback is the carrying case does not fold flat like previous generations.

headline: Disappointing headband durability
review_text: The headband started showing cracks after four months of daily commute. Expected much better build materials for this price range.

headline: Audiophile quality in wireless form
review_text: Highs are crisp without sibilance and the bass response is punchy without distorting. Highly recommend equalizer adjustments in the companion app.

headline: Average microphone in windy environments
review_text: ANC is great indoors but wind noise gets through easily outdoors when walking. It is decent overall.

headline: Stopped working after update
review_text: Bluetooth failed to reconnect immediately following the firmware update. Resetting did not resolve the issue. Returning unit.

headline: Best travel companion ever
review_text: Flew across continents with these. Battery survived both flights with ANC active. Zero ear fatigue.

headline: Phenomenal display and zoom camera
review_text: The flat antireflective screen is a major improvement. Photos at 10x and 30x zoom retain incredible sharpness. Battery lasts full two days.

headline: Great device but software feels bloated

review_date: though some AI features feel gimmicky.

headline: Too heavy and sharp corners dig into palm

headline: Incredible cushioning for everyday walking
review_text: The air bubble in the heel provides springy step response. Great ventilation on the mesh upper.

headline: Runs narrow around midfoot

headline: Squeaking air cushion defect

headline: Classic fit and durable denim

headline: Color faded too fast

headline: Mindblowing sound clarity

headline: Very good battery and connectivity

headline: Received open box unit

headline: Super ANC for studying in noisy hostel

headline: Satisfactory but expensive

headline: Beast performance and display

headline: Best flagship in the market

headline: Slow charging speed compared to competitors
